jobs.title: Professional Engineering, Flight Control Laws (CLaws) Design, Development and Analysis
jobs.description:
*When applicable, Bombardier promotes flexible and hybrid work policies.*

#### **Why join us?**

At Bombardier, we design, build and maintain the world’s peak-performing aircraft for the world’s most discerning people and businesses, governments and militaries. We have been successful in setting the highest standards by putting our people at the heart of it all, and defining excellence, together.

Working at Bombardier means operating at the highest level. Every day, you are part of a team that delivers superior experiences and products, pushing the boundaries of what's possible in our industry and beyond. By prioritizing employee growth and development, we empower everyone to reach their full potential on their own terms, because the best work happens when you are free to be yourself and share your unique expertise.

#### **Bombardier’s Benefits Program**

With our employees’ well-being top of mind, we offer a comprehensive and competitive Benefits Program, which includes the following:

* Insurance plans *(Dental, medical, life insurance, disability, and more)*
* Competitive base salary
* Retirement savings plan
* Employee Assistance Program
* Tele Health Program

### **What are your contributions to the team?**

At Bombardier, our employees work together to evolve mobility worldwide - one good idea at a time. If you have a good idea, we’ll provide the environment where it will thrive and grow into a great product or customer experience. Your ideas are our fuel.

The CLaws team is responsible for the design, development, testing and certification of the Fly-by-Wire (FBW) flight control laws for the next generation Bombardier aircraft which at present includes the Global 7000/8000 business jet. The CLaws provide a means to manage the aircraft response due to pilot inputs, to reduce pilot workload while fulfilling handling quality and performance/structural loads requirements along with providing additional flight and structural envelope protections.

  

* Develop and improve both new and existing CLaws design as well the corresponding assessment tools using Matlab and C++ programming
* Support CLaws, autopilot and navigation design development for R&D projects
* Perform CLaws requirements validation and verification (V&V) for any Claws updates and/or new Claws designs
* Verify and deliver the CLaws in accordance to the DO-178B standard and SAE ARP 4754
* Design and develop pilot in the loop CLaws based on handling quality requirements, flight and structural envelope protection requirements, performance requirements, test pilot assessments and aircraft level requirements
* Evaluate CLaws and FBW system failures, system stability and performance with analytical methods, desktop simulations, pilot in the loop simulator tests and flight test data

### **How to thrive in this role?**

* You hold a bachelor’s, master’s or PhD degree in Aerospace, Mechanical or Electrical Engineering
* You have a minimum of 5 years of pertinent experience in the development of Flight Control Laws for FBW (Fly-By-Wire) aircraft
* You have a good command in Aircraft Flight Dynamics with an in depth understanding of Aerodynamics
* You are competent in "classical" and “modern” control systems design techniques for SISO and MIMO systems and be familiar with advanced control laws techniques and methods
* You have good understanding of control law evaluation techniques, linear and non-development and testing procedures
* You have a good understanding of aircraft stability and control with a pilot-in-the-loop
* You have a good understanding of DO-178B standards, system requirements verification and validation methods and certification of complex software (ARP 4754)
* You are proficient in using Matlab and Simulink as a simulation, aircraft/system modeling and control law development tool
* You are proficient in programming Matlab scripts
* You are proficient in C++ programming
* You are fluent in written and spoken English
* You are a team player with an innovative spirit, motivated and able to work independently

**Now that you can see yourself in this role, apply and join the Bombardier Team!**

Please note: You don’t need *all* the skills, knowledge, and experience listed to apply for this position. We’re not looking for the perfect candidate, we’re looking for great talent and passionate individuals.  
  
Bombardier is an equal opportunity employer and encourages persons of any race, religion, ethnicity, gender identity, sexual orientation, age, immigration status, disability or other applicable legally protected characteristics to apply.

Registration is required. Only selected participants will be invited to attend. Registration closes on October 20, 2026, at 12:00 p.m.

Register here: https://aerocareer.ca/events/evenement-de-recrutement-en-ingenierie-2

* Collaborer avec l'équipe Liaison dans l'investigation des problèmes affectant les pièces et les assemblages.
* Diriger et présenter des rapports lors de différentes instances de gouvernance et réunions.

* Vous détenez de très fortes habiletés de gestion et posséder une vaste expérience en aéronautique

* Vous avez les valeurs et une vision qui cadres avec la philosophie de l’entreprise

Alteo is looking for a Systems Administrator (Citrix, VMware) for a permanent position based in Montreal.

\*\*\* Hybrid Work \*\*\*

You will play a key role in the design, evolution, and maintenance of the technology infrastructure. As the point person for server and systems architecture, you will ensure their performance, availability, and security. Your expertise will help implement innovative technology strategies and ensure the stability of critical environments.

RESPONSIBILITIES:

> Infrastructure Management and Development

* Maintain and upgrade virtualization environments (SAN, VMware, Citrix) and operating systems (Windows, AIX, Solaris)
* Ensuring robustness, performance, and compliance with security standards
* Automating infrastructure provisioning and optimizing capacity and performance

> Architecture and Technology Projects

* Evaluating projects related to the server fleet and recommending appropriate solutions
* Participating in defining technology strategies and implementing the architecture
* Conducting proof-of-concepts and monitoring technology trends

> Support and Coordination

* Inform and support teams during major changes
* Coordinate incident response and document solutions
* Serve as a point of contact for various departments and management

> Governance and Continuous Improvement

* Develop and implement tools, procedures, and work methods
* Ensure compliance with standards and requirements regarding stability and availability
* Participate in the development of security policies and budget planning

> Resource and Vendor Management

* Oversee the maintenance and development of IT infrastructure and networks
* Negotiate and manage contractual agreements with vendors
* Manage the procurement, inventory, and disposal of IT equipment

PROFILE:

* Bachelor’s degree in computer science or equivalent
* Recognized certification in the field of information technology (e.g., MSCE – Microsoft Certified System Engineer)
* 7+ years of experience in a similar role
* Extensive knowledge of hardware and software operating environments (infrastructure, matrices, digital signage applications, etc.)
* Expertise in virtualization with VMware 6.7 VSAN
* Very good knowledge of cloud solutions (Azure, Office 365)
* Good knowledge of Citrix environments
* Proficiency in scripting (PowerShell)
* Knowledge of incident and problem management according to the ITIL framework
* Autonomy and attention to detail: Ability to manage multiple priorities simultaneously while adhering to quality and security standards.
* Problem analysis and resolution: Critical thinking and a sense of initiative to diagnose and resolve complex issues related to IT infrastructure.
* Collaboration and technical leadership: Ability to work in a team, build trusting relationships, and positively influence technology decisions.
* Innovation and technology monitoring: A strong interest in technological advancements, virtualization, and cloud computing, coupled with a commitment to continuous improvement.
* Frequent travel: Travel may be required based on operational needs.
* On-call availability: Occasional availability outside regular hours may be required to meet departmental needs.

Nous réussissons à établir les normes les plus élevées grâce à notre approche centrée sur les personnes, et toujours en définissant l'excellence, ensemble.  
  
Travailler chez Bombardier signifie offrir ce qu’il se fait de mieux. Chaque jour, vous faites partie d’une équipe qui offre des expériences et des produits de qualité supérieure, repoussant les limites du possible dans notre industrie et au-delà. En priorisant la croissance et le développement des employées, nous permettons à chacune d'atteindre son plein potentiel à sa manière, parce que le meilleur travail se produit lorsque vous êtes libre d'être vous-même et de partager votre expertise unique.

#### **Nos avantages sociaux**

En veillant au bien-être de nos employés, nous proposons un programme d'avantages sociaux complet et compétitif, qui comprend les éléments suivants :

* Régimes d'assurance *(Soins dentaires, soins médicaux, assurance-vie, assurance-invalidité, et plus encore)*
* Salaire de base compétitif
* Régime d'épargne retraite
* Programme d'aide aux employés
* Programme de télésanté

### **Quelles sont vos contributions envers l’équipe?**

* Gérer les dossiers de non-conformité des fournisseurs relatifs aux pièces et assemblages achetés.
* Collaborer avec les fournisseurs afin de définir, déployer et suivre les plans d'action à court, moyen et long terme visant à corriger et prévenir les problèmes de qualité liés aux fournisseurs.
* Assurer à l'implantation et à l'efficacité des actions correctives chez nos fournisseurs et gérer le comité des actions correctives (CAB - Corrective Action Board)
* Soutenir à l'équipe Intégrité Produit pour la préparation et le traitement des lettres de divulgation (Disclosure Letters).
* Effectuer des analyses détaillées des tendances de non-qualité chez les fournisseurs.
* Collaborer avec l'équipe Liaison dans l'investigation des problèmes affectant les pièces et les assemblages.
* Diriger et présenter des rapports lors de différentes instances de gouvernance et réunions.

### **Comment vous épanouir dans ce rôle?**

* Vous détenez de très fortes habiletés de gestion et posséder une vaste expérience en aéronautique
* Vous posséder 10 ans d’expérience en aéronautique de préférence en système qualité
* Vous avez une formation de niveau collégial ou expérience équivalente
* Vous avez les valeurs et une vision qui cadres avec la philosophie de l’entreprise
* Vous avez une connaissance du français et de l’anglais
* Vous avez des aptitudes en communication
* Vous avez également la capacité à travailler dans des délais serrés

#### **Maintenant que vous vous projetez dans ce rôle, postulez et rejoignez l'équipe Bombardier!**

Veuillez noter: Vous n'avez pas besoin de *toutes* les compétences, connaissances et expériences requises pour postuler à ce poste ! Nous ne sommes pas à la recherche du candidat·e parfait·e, mais d'une personne talentueuse et passionnée .  
  
Bombardier est un employeur qui souscrit au principe de l'égalité d'accès à l'emploi et encourage les personnes de toute race, religion, origine ethnique, identité sexuelle, orientation sexuelle, âge, statut d'immigrant, handicap ou autres caractéristiques protégées par la loi à postuler.
